## M4 Cancel / Reschedule
Handles both cancellation_request and reschedule_request (request_type derived from intent). Upserts to Cancellations_Reschedules, notifies staff when name+phone present, texts patient (gated).
NEVER says the appointment is cancelled/rescheduled — only 'request received'.
After import: point 'Upsert Lead'→M7, 'Notify Staff'→M8, 'Send Patient SMS'→M9.
